newsitem.title: UK: Major to hold news conference on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Major to hold news conference on Wednesday.

text.p: Prime Minister John Major and Social Security Secretary Peter Lilley will hold a news conference on Wednesday at 1045 GMT, Major's office said.
The news conference follows reports that the government plans to abolish the state earnings related pensions scheme.
Major and Lilley were expected to brief accredited political correspondents, with pool arrangements in place for broadcasters and photographers.
